_comment: Entry fee tracking for the 2026/27 season. Update 'paid' as people pay, then re-run fpl_hof.py and push to update the live site.
_prizes_comment: Shown as % of the total pot until the pot is finalized (everyone paid / season underway). Once locked in, switch prize_display to 'amount' to show euro figures instead. Percentages below are calibrated so each monthly prize ~= 30 EUR assuming the full 28-manager pot (1,400 EUR) -- if fewer end up paying, the % stays fixed but actual payouts scale down proportionally.
